name: Telemetry Relay
description: Sends live telemetry (positions, item pickups, match events) from game instances to ql-stats-hub through a relay on each host, and owns the Stats Hub entries: one host entry, one instance entry and one settings section for telemetry and the live demo stream (the stream itself needs the Live Demo Stream addon 1.9.0 or newer). Needs the stream_telemetry_unified plugin on the instances.

host_stats_hub.description: The telemetry relay forwards telemetry from every instance on this host to stats-hub; the demo stream tunnel (stunnel, pinning the hub's TLS certificate) carries the live demo stream. Saving runs what changed on the host in one job; save again with the tunnel on after the hub's certificate changes to re-pin it. Switching either on lets this host's IP through the stats-hub firewall; it is taken out again once both are off.

fields.label: Telemetry relay
fields.description: Deploys and starts the relay sidecar on this host.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the Stats Hub settings. Used by telemetry and the live demo stream alike.

fields.label: Ingest token override
fields.description: Never shown once saved; leave blank to keep the stored one. Clearing the URL override clears it too.

fields.label: Forward telemetry through
fields.description: Only for a host that cannot reach stats-hub directly: the relay sends its POSTs to this address (http://host:port, a relay that forwards to stats-hub) instead. qlsm itself still talks to the stats-hub URL. stats-hub then sees the relay's address, so that address must be allowed in its firewall. Leave blank to send straight to stats-hub.

fields.label: Demo stream tunnel
fields.description: Installs and starts the tunnel for the live demo stream on this host. Needs the Live Demo Stream addon and the relay in Settings.

fields.label: Tunnel local port
fields.description: Port the tunnel listens on at 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for 27999. After a change, save each streaming instance's Stats Hub entry again so it picks up the new port.

fields.label: Demo stream relay host for this host
fields.description: Where this host's tunnel connects instead of the relay in Settings, for a host that cannot reach it directly (e.g. a TCP relay on port 443 that forwards to stats-hub). Leave both relay fields blank to use Settings. stats-hub then sees the relay's address, so that address must be allowed in its firewall.

fields.label: Demo stream relay port for this host
fields.description: Port of the relay above, e.g. 443.

instance_stats_hub.description: Telemetry and the live demo stream of this instance. One Save applies everything that changed with at most one restart; a delay change alone needs none. The server ID is reserved automatically, shared by both, and kept when switched off. The stream needs the Live Demo Stream addon; without it the stream fields are ignored.

fields.label: Send telemetry
fields.description: Needs the telemetry relay on this host (its Stats Hub entry) and the stream_telemetry_unified plugin on the instance.

fields.label: Reserve a new server ID
fields.description: Asks stats-hub for a fresh server ID on save, for telemetry and the stream; use it when two servers share one. Untick it after saving.

fields.label: Live demo stream
fields.description: Streams players' views to stats-hub so spectators can watch live. Needs the relay in Settings and the demo stream tunnel on this host.

fields.label: Stream delay (seconds)
fields.description: How far behind the live game viewers see it: 0 to 300, blank for the hub default. Set while the stream is on.

settings_stats_hub.description: The stats-hub that telemetry and the live demo stream both use, and the relay the streams connect to. Hosts may override the stats-hub in their Stats Hub entry.

fields.label: Stats-hub URL
fields.description: ql-stats-hub base URL for telemetry and the live demo stream.

fields.label: Ingest token
fields.description: STATS_HUB_INGEST_TOKEN, not STATS_HUB_API_TOKEN: the wrong one fails silently with a 401. Never shown once saved; leave blank to keep the stored one.

fields.label: Switch on new instances
fields.description: A new instance gets telemetry and the live demo stream from its first deploy, under one server ID reserved once, with no extra restart. The Stats Hub tab of the Add Instance form can turn either off or set the server ID by hand. Needs the relay (and for the stream the tunnel) already on in the host's Stats Hub entry, and a qlsm with the Add Instance addon tab.

fields.label: Demo stream relay host
fields.description: Hostname or IP the game hosts' tunnels connect to. Needs the Live Demo Stream addon.

fields.label: Demo stream relay port
fields.description: TLS ingest port of stats-hub (STATS_HUB_DEMO_STREAM_TCP_PORT).

add_instance.description: Set up before the first deploy, so the new server starts in the hub with no extra restart. Telemetry needs the relay on this host, the stream the demo stream tunnel (both in the host's Stats Hub entry); what cannot be switched on is skipped with a line in the instance log.

fields.label: Send telemetry
fields.description: Starts from the Switch on new instances setting.

fields.label: Live demo stream
fields.description: Uses the same server ID as telemetry. Needs the Live Demo Stream addon switched on.

fields.label: Server ID (optional)
fields.description: A stats-hub server ID to use instead of reserving a new one, e.g. to keep an old server's ID.
